results.description:
A city girl starting over. A former champion bull rider who's done with love. One rescued donkey determined to bring them together.

Paige Jackson lost two years of her life to grief.

Now she's finally ready to start living again.

House-sitting for an old family friend in Coyote Springs, California, seems like the perfect escape from Los Angeles—and the heartbreak she desperately needs to leave behind.

Then Paige discovers Aunt Betty's Refuge isn't exactly a peaceful country retreat.

It's an animal sanctuary.

And Paige knows absolutely nothing about animals.

Enter TJ Huey.

The former champion bull rider walked away from fame, rodeo, and relationships after success nearly destroyed him. These days, TJ is happier working his gold mine, helping his foster mother with her collection of rescued animals, and keeping his heart safely out of the equation.

Until he nearly hits a pregnant donkey on a country road.

Saving the abused little jenny—quickly christened Miss Valentine—throws TJ and Paige together in ways neither expects. The polished LA newcomer may look completely out of place in Coyote Springs, but her fierce determination to earn Miss Valentine's trust makes TJ reconsider everything he assumed about her.

And Paige discovers there's far more beneath the guarded cowboy's rough exterior than she expected.

As Miss Valentine begins to heal, so do they.

But opening your heart after losing faith in love takes courage—and sometimes the hardest thing to rescue is yourself.

HER GOLD COUNTRY COWBOY is a heartwarming small-town cowboy romance filled with opposites-attract chemistry, a former rodeo champion, a city-girl heroine starting over, adorable rescue animals, emotional healing, found family, and a feel-good happily-ever-after.
